items.title: Multi-omics approach to map a clinically diverse large cohort with homozygous founder RAG1 p.C176F variant among Old Order Mennonites
items.abstract_or_text: Partially preserved function of recombination-activating genes (RAG) 1 and 2 can be linked to divergent and hard-to-predict clinical and immunological phenotypes, even among close relatives. It is unclear how intrinsic RAG hypomorphism interacts with extrinsic environmental pressures to shape clinical trajectory. We dissect this phenomenon in a unique cohort of 18 Old Order Mennonite individuals with a novel missense founder RAG1 variant (p.C176F) with 25.8% recombinase activity of wild-type protein. After studying a myriad of markers, we demonstrate varying severity and progression of clinical disease (predominantly in females) that paralleled decline in CMV-specific immune competence, break in tolerance with hallmark presence of antibodies to IFN, a TH1/IFN{gamma}-driven inflammatory milieu with elevated serum markers (CXCL9/10), expansion of follicular helper T cells and clonal B cells enriched for autoreactive-prone VH4.34 B cell receptor. BCR and TCR repertoires carry the fingerprints of both extrinsic and RAG-driven intrinsic changes. Through this experiment of nature, our cohort demonstrated that partial RAG deficiency (pRD) is not a monolithic disease but the result of compounded RAG intrinsic and extrinsic events. Overall, this study uses multi-omics approaches to dissect the contribution of a hypomorphic RAG variant to variable severity of clinical disease and immunological dysregulation at cellular and molecular level. Emerging biomarkers of a multi-omic roadmap should allow monitoring of progression of clinical disease and guide who and when to treat with hematopoietic stem cell transplant in pRD.
items.summary_zh: 研究18名 Old Order Mennonite 人群中 RAG1 p.C176F 低功能变异，通过临床、单细胞免疫、代谢及 BCR/TCR 组学解析部分 RAG 缺陷的异质性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是一个独特的自然实验队列，连接遗传变异、免疫失衡和临床进展，并提出可用于监测和造血干细胞移植决策的多组学生物标志物路线。
items.abstract_zh: 重组激活基因 RAG1 和 RAG2 的部分保留功能可能与不同且难以预测的临床和免疫学表型相关，即使在近亲之间也是如此。目前尚不清楚内在的 RAG 低功能如何与外在环境压力相互作用以塑造临床轨迹。我们分析了一个独特的队列，其中18名 Old Order Mennonite 个体携带一种新的错义创始变异 RAG1 p.C176F；该变异具有野生型蛋白25.8%的重组酶活性。在研究多种标志物后，我们显示疾病严重程度和进展各不相同（主要见于女性），并与 CMV 特异性免疫能力下降、耐受性破坏以及 IFN 抗体的典型存在相一致；同时观察到 TH1/IFN{gamma} 驱动的炎症环境，血清 CXCL9/10 升高，滤泡辅助性 T 细胞和克隆性 B 细胞扩增，且后者富集具有自身反应倾向的 VH4.34 B 细胞受体。BCR 和 TCR 组库带有外在因素和 RAG 驱动内在变化的特征。通过这一自然实验，我们的队列显示，部分 RAG 缺陷（pRD）并非单一疾病，而是 RAG 内在因素与外在因素共同作用的结果。总体而言，本研究使用多组学方法，在细胞和分子层面剖析低功能 RAG 变异对疾病严重程度差异和免疫失调的影响。正在出现的多组学生物标志物路线图应有助于监测疾病进展，并指导 pRD 患者何时以及是否接受造血干细胞移植。

items.title: Protein Language Model-Conditioned Graph Neural Networks for Multitask GPCR Ligand Activity Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Predicting ligand activity across G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) requires models that capture both molecular structure and receptor-specific information while remaining robust to chemical and target-domain shifts. We developed a multimodal graph neural network that combines explicit ligand molecular graphs with frozen protein language model representations of GPCR sequences and jointly predicts quantitative pActivity and binary activity. The model was trained on 271,739 curated ligand-GPCR pairs spanning 183,694 ligands and 216 human GPCRs and evaluated using random, Bemis-Murcko scaffold, and strict cold-ligand partitions. With ESM-2 650M receptor embeddings, the selected model achieved mean absolute errors of 0.513 ± 0.006, 0.540 ± 0.006, and 0.641 ± 0.005 pActivity units under random, cold-ligand, and scaffold evaluation, respectively, substantially outperforming a protein-aware fixed-feature multilayer perceptron and consistently improving quantitative prediction over a matched GINE reference. Removing receptor embeddings markedly degraded both regression and classification, whereas differences among ESM-2 35M, ESM-2 650M, and ProtT5 were comparatively small. Independent evaluation on 6,319 ChEMBL 37/BindingDB pairs revealed a substantial external domain shift, with mean absolute error increasing to approximately 0.94-0.95 despite chemically stringent internal validation. Nevertheless, receptor-specific information remained highly informative in a DRD2-DRD3 selectivity analysis: the cold-ligand ensemble achieved R^2 = 0.853, Spearman ρ = 0.916, and ROC-AUC = 0.966 for strong DRD3 selectivity, whereas the receptor-independent ablation approached chance-level discrimination. These results establish protein-language-model-conditioned molecular graph learning as a scalable strategy for GPCR bioactivity prediction while identifying chemotype novelty, external-domain transfer, and richer ligand-receptor interaction representations as key remaining challenges.
items.summary_zh: 构建融合配体分子图和冻结 GPCR 蛋白语言模型表示的多模态图神经网络，在27万余个配体—GPCR 配对上预测定量与二元活性，并检验冷配体、骨架和外部域迁移。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 显示受体序列表示对 GPCR 活性和选择性预测有增益，同时量化外部域偏移，避免将内部验证性能直接视为跨化学空间泛化。
items.abstract_zh: 预测 G 蛋白偶联受体（GPCR）的配体活性，需要模型同时捕捉分子结构和受体特异性信息，并且在化学空间和靶点域发生变化时保持稳健。我们开发了一种多模态图神经网络，将显式配体分子图与冻结的蛋白质语言模型 GPCR 序列表征结合起来，并联合预测定量 pActivity 和二元活性。模型在覆盖183,694种配体和216个人类 GPCR 的271,739个经整理的配体—GPCR 配对上训练，并采用随机、Bemis-Murcko 骨架和严格冷配体划分进行评估。使用 ESM-2 650M 受体嵌入时，所选模型在随机、冷配体和骨架评估下的平均绝对误差分别为0.513 ± 0.006、0.540 ± 0.006和0.641 ± 0.005个 pActivity 单位，显著优于基于蛋白质信息的固定特征多层感知器，并且在定量预测上始终优于匹配的 GINE 参考模型。移除受体嵌入会明显降低回归和分类性能，而 ESM-2 35M、ESM-2 650M 和 ProtT5 之间的差异相对较小。在包含6,319个 ChEMBL 37/BindingDB 配对的独立评估中，观察到显著的外部域偏移，平均绝对误差升高到约0.94—0.95。尽管如此，在 DRD2-DRD3 选择性分析中，受体特异性信息仍然非常有用：冷配体集成模型在强 DRD3 选择性判别中达到 R^2 = 0.853、Spearman ρ = 0.916 和 ROC-AUC = 0.966，而不依赖受体的消融模型接近随机水平。这些结果确立了蛋白质语言模型条件化分子图学习作为 GPCR 生物活性预测的可扩展策略，同时指出化学型新颖性、外部域迁移和更丰富的配体—受体相互作用表征仍是关键挑战。
items.author_line: De M, Lodh E, Majumder S, Chowdhury T

items.title: A Lenalidomide-Inducible Suicide Switch for Gene- and Cell-Based Therapy
items.abstract_or_text: Genetically modified immune effector cells, including chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cells, have emerged as transformative anti-cancer agents. However, these autonomous, living therapies are limited by difficult-to-control hyperactivation toxicities. To achieve their full potential as therapies for a broader range of diseases, CAR T cells must target novel antigens and integrate further potency enhancements that raise the possibility of novel and intensified toxicities. High performance safety systems are needed to restrain these highly active next-generation gene- and cell-based therapies. Cell therapy suicide switches remain infrequently used, and are currently limited by inaccessible controller drugs, incomplete cell depletion, fitness cost, and immunogenicity. To address these issues, we engineered a fully human sequence-based cell therapy suicide switch based on the overexpression of Caspase-Activated DNase (CAD) and its stoichiometric chaperone/inhibitor ICAD fused to a lenalidomide-inducible degron. Acute destabilization of ICAD with the broadly available, off-patent molecular glue degrader drug lenalidomide uncaged CAD to induce DNA damage and cell death. By this degradable cage mechanism, the ICAD-CAD suicide switch achieved long-term expression in primary human T cells without detectable leakiness, and deep drug-induced cell depletion. The ICAD-CAD switch was generalizable to alternative acute destabilization systems. Genome-wide CRISPR screening established the necessity of CAD and the lenalidomide-interacting E3 ubiquitin ligase substrate adaptor CRBN for switch function. When co-delivered with a CAR, ICAD-CAD CAR T cells retained effector functions and could be rapidly depleted with lenalidomide.
items.summary_zh: 设计基于 ICAD-CAD 和来那度胺诱导降解的全人源细胞治疗自杀开关，在原代人 T 细胞和 CAR-T 细胞中实现低泄漏表达及药物诱导清除。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为高活性基因和细胞疗法提供可用的安全控制机制，并以全基因组 CRISPR 筛选验证 CAD 和 CRBN 对开关功能的必要性。
items.abstract_zh: 包括嵌合抗原受体（CAR）T 细胞在内的基因修饰免疫效应细胞，已经成为变革性抗癌药物。然而，这些自主的活细胞疗法受到难以控制的过度激活毒性的限制。为了使其能够用于更广泛的疾病，CAR T 细胞必须靶向新的抗原并整合更多增强效力的设计，这会增加出现新型且更严重毒性的可能性。需要高性能安全系统来约束这些高活性的下一代基因和细胞疗法。细胞疗法自杀开关的使用仍不普遍，目前受限于控制药物不可获得、细胞清除不完全、适应度代价和免疫原性。为解决这些问题，我们工程化构建了一种完全基于人源序列的细胞疗法自杀开关，其基础是过表达 Caspase-Activated DNase（CAD）及其化学计量伴侣/抑制因子 ICAD，并将 ICAD-CAD 与来那度胺诱导型降解标签融合。通过广泛可获得且已失去专利保护的分子胶降解剂来那度胺急性 destabilization ICAD，使 CAD 脱笼并诱导 DNA 损伤和细胞死亡。借助这种可降解笼机制，ICAD-CAD 自杀开关在原代人 T 细胞中实现长期表达且未检测到泄漏，并实现了深度的药物诱导细胞清除。该 ICAD-CAD 开关可推广到其他急性 destabilization 系统。全基因组 CRISPR 筛选证实，CAD 以及来那度胺相互作用的 E3 泛素连接酶底物适配蛋白 CRBN 对开关功能是必需的。当与 CAR 共递送时，ICAD-CAD CAR T 细胞保留效应功能，并可通过来那度胺快速清除。

items.title: Veillonella dispar triggers dual-hits in the pathogenesis of autoimmune hepatitis and primary biliary cholangitis via testosterone depletion-BAFF-B cell axis and Th17 cell activation
items.abstract_or_text: Objective: Autoimmune hepatitis (AIH) and primary biliary cholangitis (PBC) frequently present as overlap syndromes, characterized by shared sexual dimorphism and elevated intestinal Veillonella dispar (V. dispar) abundance, yet exhibiting distinct hallmark pathological manifestations. This study aimed to elucidate the shared pathogenesis, phenotypic differentiation mechanisms and sex-specific predisposition of AIH and PBC induced by V. dispar. Methods: Clean-grade and germ-free (GF) mice were employed to establish AIH and PBC models. Model induction involved oral gavage of V. dispar and intraperitoneal injection of either liver-specific antigen S100 (for AIH) or a pyruvate dehydrogenase complex E2 subunit (PDC-E2) mimetic peptide (for PBC). Single-cell RNA sequencing, metabolomics, transmission electron microscopy, western blotting, and flow cytometry were utilized to elucidate the underlying mechanisms. Results: V. dispar successfully induced autoimmune liver disease-like features in mice, characterized by significant intrahepatic B cell infiltration. Mechanistically, V. dispar caused systemic arginine reduction, leading to intrinsic apoptosis of gonadal stromal cells and a subsequent reduction in testosterone. This decreased testosterone weakened its inhibitory effect on B cell activating factor (BAFF) secretion, thereby amplifying B cell-mediated immune responses. Furthermore, in the presence of S100 or PDC-E2 mimetic peptide, V. dispar also facilitated Th17 cell activation, which guided the phenotypic differentiation into AIH or PBC, respectively. Consistent with these findings, our clinical observations revealed that patients with AIH and PBC tended to harbor enriched V. dispar, along with lower serum arginine and testosterone. In addition, elevated serum levels of BAFF and IL-17 were also observed in these patients. Conclusion: V. dispar induces reduced testosterone levels and upregulation of BAFF, leading to intrahepatic B cell expansion, which serves as the common pathogenic basis for AIH and PBC. The presence of S100 and PDC-E2 subsequently drives further maturation of these expanded B cells and promotes Th17 cell activation, thereby determining the phenotypic divergence between AIH and PBC.
items.summary_zh: 在小鼠模型和临床观察中研究 Veillonella dispar 对自身免疫性肝炎与原发性胆汁性胆管炎的影响，提出精氨酸下降—睾酮下降—BAFF—B 细胞轴和 Th17 激活的双重机制模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结合无菌小鼠、单细胞转录组、代谢组和患者观察，连接肠道菌、性别相关信号与自身免疫表型；机制链条仍应视为该研究支持的模型，不能替代因果临床证据。
items.abstract_zh: 目的：自身免疫性肝炎（AIH）和原发性胆汁性胆管炎（PBC）经常以重叠综合征形式出现，其特征包括共同的性别二态性和升高的肠道 Veillonella dispar（V. dispar）丰度，但两者又表现出不同的典型病理表现。本研究旨在阐明由 V. dispar 诱导的 AIH 和 PBC 的共同发病机制、表型分化机制和性别特异性易感性。方法：研究使用清洁级和无菌（GF）小鼠建立 AIH 和 PBC 模型。模型诱导包括灌胃 V. dispar，并分别腹腔注射肝脏特异性抗原 S100（用于 AIH）或丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体 E2 亚基（PDC-E2）模拟肽（用于 PBC）。研究采用单细胞 RNA 测序、代谢组学、透射电子显微镜、western blotting 和流式细胞术阐明潜在机制。结果：V. dispar 成功诱导了类似自身免疫性肝病的特征，其特点是肝内 B 细胞显著浸润。从机制上看，V. dispar 导致全身精氨酸减少，引起性腺基质细胞内在性凋亡，继而导致睾酮下降。睾酮下降减弱了其对 B 细胞活化因子（BAFF）分泌的抑制作用，从而放大了 B 细胞介导的免疫反应。此外，在 S100 或 PDC-E2 模拟肽存在时，V. dispar 还促进 Th17 细胞活化，引导表型向 AIH 或 PBC 分化。与此一致，我们的临床观察显示，AIH 和 PBC 患者往往具有更高的 V. dispar 丰度，同时血清精氨酸和睾酮较低。此外，这些患者的血清 BAFF 和 IL-17 水平也升高。结论：V. dispar 诱导睾酮水平降低和 BAFF 上调，导致肝内 B 细胞扩增，这构成共同的致病基础。随后 S100 和 PDC-E2 促使这些扩增的 B 细胞进一步成熟，并促进 Th17 细胞活化，从而决定表型分化。

items.title: FORALL-LEAN-AGENT for Auditable Reasoning in Formal Mathematics and Software Verification
items.abstract_or_text: Coding agents increasingly automate Lean proof development, but successful compilation alone does not establish that a candidate proves the intended statement under acceptable assumptions. We present FORALL-LEAN-AGENT, a frontend-agnostic framework for auditable reasoning in formal mathematics and software verification. The framework combines isolated workspaces, Lean tools, and fresh review with statement comparison, axiom audits, and independent proof checking where supported. Verification evidence and reviewer decisions are bound to the same candidate artifact, making acceptance traceable. We evaluate the framework on VeriSoftBench, PutnamBench, and both problems in the Lean Eval softwareverification track. On the 100-task VeriSoftBench subset, integration with FORALLLEAN-AGENT raises benchmark-rule success from 93 to 100 for GPT-5.6 Sol at low effort while reducing cost from 69 to 62. The PutnamBench evaluation accepts all 672 problems at an average of 4.72 each. These results show that agent harness design can improve correctness and efficiency while providing evidence beyond aggregate solve counts.
items.summary_zh: FORALL-LEAN-AGENT 将 Lean 工具、隔离工作区、陈述对照、公理审计和独立复核绑定到同一候选证明工件，提供可追溯的形式化数学与软件验证审计流程。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把“成功编译”与“确实证明目标命题且假设可接受”区分开，并在 VeriSoftBench、PutnamBench 和 Lean Eval softwareverification 赛道上报告了可核验的成功率与成本变化。
items.abstract_zh: 编程代理日益自动化 Lean 证明开发，但成功编译本身并不能证明候选证明了预期命题且使用了可接受的假设。我们提出 FORALL-LEAN-AGENT，一个面向形式化数学和软件验证、与前端无关的可审计推理框架。该框架结合隔离工作区、Lean 工具和新鲜复核，并在适用时进行陈述比较、公理审计和独立证明检查。验证证据与复核者决定绑定到同一候选工件，使验收过程可追溯。我们在 VeriSoftBench、PutnamBench 以及 Lean Eval 的 softwareverification 赛道中的两个问题上评估该框架。在 VeriSoftBench 的 100 个任务子集上，与 FORALL-LEAN-AGENT 集成后，GPT-5.6 Sol 在低推理强度下的基准规则成功数从 93 提升到 100，同时成本从 69 降至 62。PutnamBench 评测接受了全部 672 道题，平均每题 4.72 次。结果表明，代理工具链设计可以在提供超越总体求解数量的证据的同时，提高正确性和效率。
items.author_line: Naing Oo Lwin

items.title: SkillEvoLean: Mutation-enhanced skill evolution for Lean provers
items.abstract_or_text: Skill evolution offers a promising way to improve large language model agents without updating their parameters, but its use in formal theorem proving remains underexplored. Existing methods mainly target natural-language reasoning, improving skills by analyzing successful and failed trajectories and incrementally revising solving strategies. Although the Lean verifier provides reliable execution feedback, when all sampled trajectories fail, existing skill evolution methods lack successful trajectories from which to infer effective update directions. Furthermore, these methods also focus mainly on the root instruction file, thus underexploring the evolution of reference knowledge including mathematical concepts and proving techniques. To address these limitations, we propose a mutation-enhanced skill self-evolution framework for building skill-augmented Lean provers. The framework jointly evolves a high-level solving policy and its reference knowledge through progressive and mutation-based updates. Progressive evolution derives local improvements from successful and failed trajectories, while mutation is triggered when no complete proof can be generated, sampling mathematical concepts to produce and select new skill candidates under verifier feedback. We evaluate our method on MiniF2F, PutnamBench, the 2025 International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO 2025), and the 2026 USA Mathematical Olympiad (USAMO 2026). Under the same backbone model, trajectorysampling budget, and test-time compute, our method achieves proof success rates of 100.0%, 90.6%, 4/6, and 4/6, respectively, with GPT-5.5, outperforming the baseline methods. Further analysis shows that concept-guided mutation outperforms random-text-guided mutation by 6.9 and 8.2 percentage points on MiniF2F and PutnamBench, respectively, while solving one additional problem on both IMO 2025 and USAMO 2026.
items.summary_zh: SkillEvoLean 在 Lean 定理证明中联合演化求解策略与数学参考知识；当轨迹全部失败时，以概念引导的变异生成新技能，并由 Lean 验证器筛选。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法在 MiniF2F、PutnamBench、IMO 2025 和 USAMO 2026 上给出明确成功率，并在相同骨干模型、采样预算和测试时计算量下超过基线。
items.abstract_zh: 技能演化为在不更新参数的情况下改进大型语言模型代理提供了有前景的方向，但其在形式化定理证明中的应用仍研究不足。现有方法主要面向自然语言推理，通过分析成功和失败轨迹、逐步修订求解策略来改进技能。尽管 Lean 验证器提供了可靠的执行反馈，但当所有采样轨迹都失败时，现有技能演化方法缺少可据以推断有效更新方向的成功轨迹。此外，这些方法也主要关注根指令文件，对包括数学概念和证明技巧在内的参考知识演化探索不足。为解决这些限制，我们提出一种用于构建技能增强型 Lean 证明器的、结合变异的技能自演化框架。该框架通过渐进式更新和基于变异的更新，联合演化高层求解策略及其参考知识。渐进式演化从成功和失败轨迹中提取局部改进；当无法生成完整证明时，则触发变异，在验证器反馈下采样数学概念，以生成并筛选新的技能候选。我们在 MiniF2F、PutnamBench、2025 年国际数学奥林匹克（IMO 2025）和 2026 年美国数学奥林匹克（USAMO 2026）上评估该方法。在相同骨干模型、轨迹采样预算和测试时计算量下，使用 GPT-5.5 时，该方法的证明成功率分别达到 100.0%、90.6%、4/6 和 4/6，并超过基线方法。进一步分析显示，在 MiniF2F 和 PutnamBench 上，概念引导的变异分别比随机文本引导的变异高 6.9 和 8.2 个百分点；在 IMO 2025 和 USAMO 2026 上，两者都多解决了一道题。
items.author_line: Kuo Zhou, ZiXion Yang, Lu Zhang

items.title: Function-Structured Reinforcement Learning with Executable Verifiers for Mathematical Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Algorithmic mathematical reasoning requires reliable decomposition, computation, and aggregation. Final-answer rewards provide limited guidance on intermediate errors, while successful execution does not guarantee mathematical correctness. This work proposes Function-Structured Graph Reinforcement Learning (FSG-RL), connecting subproblem graphs and Python implementations with multi-verifier feedback. The policy first learns to generate code from function graphs through supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) then optimizes the policy using answer-gated rewards and span-level credit assignment. The framework also supports teacher supervision and structured memory. A benchmark curated from Grade School Math 8K (GSM8K), MathQA, MATH, and Omni-MATH pairs public function graphs with private verification specifications. Under a unified evaluation protocol, GRPO improves final-answer accuracy from 43.25% to 67.50% and full solution success from 32.25% to 52.25% over SFT. Continued reinforcement learning (RL) with teacher supervision yields additional gains. The gains extend beyond producing correctly formatted code, supporting verifier-guided reinforcement learning for mathematical reasoning. Code is available at https://github.com/ZihanLiummyycc/FSG-RL.
items.summary_zh: FSG-RL 将子问题函数图、Python 实现和多重可执行验证器结合，用答案门控奖励与片段级信用分配训练算法化数学推理。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 基准把公开函数图与私有验证规格配对，报告了从 SFT 到 GRPO 的最终答案准确率和完整解成功率提升，能检验模型是否真正完成了推理而非只生成可执行代码。
items.abstract_zh: 算法化数学推理需要可靠的分解、计算和聚合。最终答案奖励对中间错误提供的指导有限，而成功执行也不保证数学正确性。本文提出函数结构图强化学习（Function-Structured Graph Reinforcement Learning，FSG-RL），将子问题图和 Python 实现与多重验证器反馈连接起来。策略首先通过监督微调（SFT）学习根据函数图生成代码；随后，组相对策略优化（GRPO）使用答案门控奖励和片段级信用分配来优化策略。该框架还支持教师监督和结构化记忆。我们从 Grade School Math 8K（GSM8K）、MathQA、MATH 和 Omni-MATH 中整理出一个基准，将公开函数图与私有验证规格配对。在统一评测协议下，相比 SFT，GRPO 将最终答案准确率从 43.25% 提高到 67.50%，将完整解成功率从 32.25% 提高到 52.25%。继续进行带教师监督的强化学习（RL）还能带来额外收益。这些提升并不只是生成格式正确的代码，说明验证器引导的强化学习能够支持数学推理。代码见 https://github.com/ZihanLiummyycc/FSG-RL。
items.author_line: Zihan Liu, Xurong Xie

items.title: Detecting Inconsistencies in Model Specifications with LLM-as-Verifier Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Model specifications define how large language models (LLMs) should behave, guiding alignment training, inference-time behavior, and evaluation. Yet these specifications may themselves contain defects: two individually reasonable principles may prescribe incompatible behavior when applied to the same situation, leaving no response that satisfies both. Detecting such inconsistencies is challenging. Formalizing natural-language specifications risks losing subtle distinctions, while behavior-based testing cannot reliably distinguish specification defects from differences in model behavior. We introduce VeriSpec, the first approach to directly detect inconsistencies in model specifications by auditing the specification text itself. Our key insight is to preserve the specification in natural language while using an LLM as a verifier. VeriSpec extracts structured, context-aware rules, constructs a topic-guided graph to cluster behaviorally related rules at the same authority level, and applies LLM-as-verifier reasoning to detect inconsistencies. Applying VeriSpec to the OpenAI Model Spec, we extract 405 rules and manually validate five inconsistencies, all reported to its developers, who responded positively and have initiated internal discussions. Compared with five baselines, VeriSpec identifies the most validated inconsistencies, achieves the highest precision (38.5%), and incurs the lowest cost per validated inconsistency (11.12). These results establish direct specification auditing as a practical complement to behavioral alignment evaluation, catching defects at the source before they shape any model. The code is available at https://github.com/HIPREL-Group/VeriSpec.
items.summary_zh: VeriSpec 直接审计自然语言模型规范：抽取带上下文的规则、按主题聚类，并用 LLM 作为验证器发现相互不相容的规范。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把规范缺陷与模型行为差异分开，在 OpenAI Model Spec 中人工确认 5 个不一致，并报告精确率、成本和基线比较，结果可复核。
items.abstract_zh: 模型规范规定大型语言模型（LLM）应如何行为，为对齐训练、推理时行为和评估提供指导。然而，这些规范本身也可能存在缺陷：两个各自合理的原则在应用于同一情境时可能规定不相容的行为，使得不存在同时满足二者的响应。检测这类不一致很困难。将自然语言形式化可能丢失细微区别，而基于行为的测试无法可靠地区分规范缺陷与模型行为差异。我们提出 VeriSpec，这是首个直接通过审计规范文本来检测模型规范不一致的方法。其关键思想是在保留自然语言规范的同时使用 LLM 作为验证器。VeriSpec 抽取结构化、具有上下文的规则，构建主题引导的图来聚类同一权威层级中行为相关的规则，并应用 LLM 作为验证器的推理来检测不一致。将 VeriSpec 应用于 OpenAI Model Spec 时，我们抽取出 405 条规则，并人工验证了 5 个不一致；这些问题均已报告给其开发者，开发者对此作出积极回应并已开始内部讨论。与 5 个基线相比，VeriSpec 找到的经验证不一致最多，取得最高精确率（38.5%），并使每个经验证不一致的成本最低（11.12）。这些结果表明，直接审计规范是行为对齐评估的实用补充，可以在缺陷影响模型之前从源头发现它们。代码见 https://github.com/HIPREL-Group/VeriSpec。
items.author_line: Zichen Xie, Mrigank Pawagi, Lize Shao, Yang Hu, Wenxi Wang

items.title: VeriHarness: Scaling Agentic Verification for Long-Horizon Tasks
items.abstract_or_text: As LLM agents undertake increasingly complex, long-horizon tasks, verifying their outputs becomes increasingly challenging. We study how verification capability can be strengthened with a fixed base model, without access to reference answers or grading rubrics at test time. Repeated sampling yields multiple rollouts that can contain complementary correct claims, but we need a reliable verification mechanism to determine which claims to trust. We first find that disagreement often exposes correct alternatives, while consensus can conceal errors. These observations motivate VeriHarness, which turns the underlying LLM a generator uses into an agentic verifier by giving it a workspace, evidence tools, and reusable verification skills. A disagreement resolver checks competing claims against environmental evidence, while a consensus challenger tests shared claims and searches for omitted requirements. Their findings guide the selection and revision of the final artifact. Across five long-horizon workspace benchmarks and two frontier models, VeriHarness achieves the highest selection scores among the evaluated baselines. Evidence-backed revision further improves average performance, bringing gains over a single rollout to 6.2 points with Gemini 3.5 Flash and 6.4 points with Claude Opus 4.8. We further show that verification skills can self-improve from failure feedback, demonstrating VeriHarness as a novel and critical approach for scaling long-horizon agentic verification. We release the full pool of approximately 26,000 rollouts across all five benchmarks and both models, produced at a cost of over 100,000, to support future research on agentic verification.
items.summary_zh: VeriHarness 为长程代理加入工作区、证据工具和可复用验证技能，通过解决分歧、挑战共识以及基于证据的修订来选择最终工件。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 5 个长程工作区基准和 2 个前沿模型上，它以选择分数领先基线，并公开约 26,000 条轨迹，评测材料较完整。
items.abstract_zh: 随着 LLM 代理承担越来越复杂的长程任务，验证其输出也变得越来越困难。我们研究在测试时无法获得参考答案或评分标准的情况下，如何在固定基础模型的前提下增强验证能力。重复采样会产生多条轨迹，其中可能包含互补的正确断言，但需要可靠的验证机制来判断哪些断言值得信任。我们首先发现，分歧常常暴露正确的替代答案，而共识可能掩盖错误。这些观察促成了 VeriHarness：通过提供工作区、证据工具和可复用验证技能，将生成器所基于的 LLM 转化为代理验证器。分歧解决器根据环境证据检查相互竞争的断言；共识挑战器测试共同断言并寻找遗漏要求。它们的发现会指导最终工件的选择和修订。在 5 个长程工作区基准和 2 个前沿模型上，VeriHarness 在所评估基线中取得最高选择分数。基于证据的修订进一步提高平均性能：相对于单条轨迹，Gemini 3.5 Flash 提升 6.2 个百分点，Claude Opus 4.8 提升 6.4 个百分点。我们还表明，验证技能可以从失败反馈中自我改进，显示 VeriHarness 是扩展长程代理验证能力的一种新方法，并且是关键方法。我们公开了 5 个基准和 2 个模型上的约 26,000 条完整轨迹，其生成成本超过 100,000，以支持后续代理验证研究。
items.author_line: Caiqi Zhang, Rujun Han, Zifeng Wang, Zoey CuiZhu, Nigel Collier, Tomas Pfister, Chen-Yu Lee

items.title: How Much Can Language Models Gain from Test-Time Computation?
items.abstract_or_text: How much can test-time computation improve a language model, and at what cost? Test-time scaling is widely proposed as a substitute for larger models, but existing comparisons mostly evaluate one domain at a time and rarely charge selection to the budget. We introduce SELF-POT, a benchmark and evaluation framework that measures the test-time potential of a model across competition mathematics, competitive programming, and agentic workflows. SELF-POT separates candidate coverage from final accuracy on static tasks, tracks correctness transitions under revision, and measures protocol completion alongside task success in agentic environments. Under a unified budget rule, it compares Direct inference with parallel sampling and self-revision under fixed multiples of the Direct budget, and charges every model call, including selection and critique, in dollars. This design supports two kinds of comparison: the gain a model obtains from additional inference, and a lower-cost model with additional inference against a stronger model. Across five low-cost reasoning models on 350 sealed tasks, with Claude Opus 5.5 Direct as the reference, the returns depend on the domain, the selection rule, and failure handling. When we replay the retained programming candidate pools, public-example selection raises correct submissions from 376 to 453 of 500 scheduled cells while saving 12-49% of logical API cost across models, and simply retaining an available candidate when judging fails recovers 61 submissions at unchanged cost. On identical mathematics pools, judging with fallback yields 186 correct submissions versus 182 for voting, while voting saves 12-21% of logical API cost. These controlled replays show how selection and failure handling change the gains realized from the same generated candidates, and they quantify the marginal value of a model judge.
items.summary_zh: SELF-POT 统一测量测试时计算在竞赛数学、竞赛编程和代理工作流中的收益，把候选覆盖、修订后的正确性、协议完成度以及所有模型调用成本纳入评测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它用封闭任务和统一预算比较并行采样、自我修订、投票与评判回退，揭示选择规则和失败处理会改变同一候选池能获得的收益。
items.abstract_zh: 测试时计算能让语言模型提升多少、代价又是多少？测试时扩展被广泛提出作为替代更大模型的方案，但现有比较大多一次只评估一个领域，而且很少将选择过程计入预算。我们提出 SELF-POT，一个在竞赛数学、竞赛编程和代理工作流中测量模型测试时潜力的基准与评测框架。对于静态任务，SELF-POT 将候选覆盖率与最终准确率分开，跟踪修订过程中的正确性转变；对于代理环境，则测量协议完成度以及任务成功率。在统一预算规则下，它在直接推理预算固定倍数的条件下比较直接推理、并行采样和自我修订，并以美元计费每一次模型调用，包括选择和批评。该设计支持两类比较：模型从额外推理中获得的收益，以及通过增加推理让低成本模型与更强模型相比的表现。在 350 个封闭任务上对 5 个低成本推理模型进行评测，并以 Claude Opus 5.5 的直接推理作为参考，结果显示收益取决于领域、选择规则和失败处理。当我们重放保留的编程候选池时，公开样例选择使 500 个计划单元中的正确提交数从 376 增加到 453，同时在不同模型上节省 12%–49% 的逻辑 API 成本；当评判失败时简单保留一个可用候选，则在成本不变的情况下挽回 61 次提交。在相同的数学候选池上，带回退的评判得到 186 个正确提交，而投票为 182 个；投票节省 12%–21% 的逻辑 API 成本。这些受控重放表明，对同一批生成候选，选择和失败处理会改变实际获得的收益，并量化了模型评判器的边际价值。
items.author_line: Bangji Yang, Jingyuan Li, Jiajun Fan, Yi Evie Zhang, Ruihan Guo, Hongba Ma, Neil He, Chumeng Liang, Qinglong Zheng, Zhanghan Ni, Ge Liu

items.title: The Missing Primitive: Diagnosing and Repairing Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated striking capabilities on frontier mathematical problems, it remains unclear whether they possess the structural mathematical understanding underlying their solutions. In this paper, we take a first step toward systematically studying mathematical understanding in LLMs, from diagnosing its distinct capabilities to leveraging these findings to improve post-training. First, we introduce the notion of Mathematical Primitive to probe structural mathematical understanding and propose , a novel benchmark that evaluates mathematical reasoning along four distinct dimensions: Discovery, Generation, Digestion, and Execution. Second, our systematic diagnosis shows that solution accuracy masks distinct capability profiles, primitives unlock substantial latent execution capacity, and Discovery is the dominant bottleneck in mathematical reasoning. Our post-training analysis further shows that discovery-limited failures are particularly amenable to repair. Finally, building on these findings, we introduce , a primitive-privileged self-distillation framework that selectively transfers primitive-guided reasoning into the student model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that consistently improves mathematical reasoning over baselines across model scales and challenging benchmarks.
items.summary_zh: 该工作用“数学原语”把数学推理拆成发现、生成、消化和执行四个维度，指出解答准确率会掩盖能力结构，并尝试用原语引导的自蒸馏修复瓶颈。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它提供了比单一答对率更细的数学能力诊断，并在多个模型规模和困难基准上测试后训练改进；摘要未给出所提基准和框架的名称，因而不作补充命名。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在前沿数学问题上展现出惊人的能力，但它们是否具备支撑这些解答的结构性数学理解仍不清楚。本文首先系统研究 LLM 的数学理解，从诊断其不同能力到利用这些发现改进后训练。首先，我们提出“数学原语”这一概念，用于探测结构性数学理解，并提出一个新的基准，从发现、生成、消化和执行四个不同维度评估数学推理。其次，我们的系统诊断表明，解答准确率会掩盖不同的能力画像；数学原语能够释放大量潜在的执行能力；而发现是数学推理的主要瓶颈。我们的后训练分析进一步表明，受发现限制的失败尤其适合修复。最后，基于这些发现，我们引入一种以原语为特权信息的自蒸馏框架，有选择地将原语引导的推理迁移到学生模型。大量实验表明，该方法在不同模型规模和具有挑战性的基准上持续改善相对于基线的数学推理。
items.author_line: Shuo Xing, Zilin Dai, Chengyuan Qian, Fangzhou Lin, Wenjing Chen, Ping He, Pan Lu, Alvaro Velasquez, Mohit Bansal, Zhengzhong Tu

items.title: Auto-Formalizing Neuro-Symbolic Predictors
items.abstract_or_text: Neuro-Symbolic (NeSy) predictors incorporate prior knowledge into the prediction process of neural networks, ensuring that outputs satisfy specified constraints, making them particularly suitable for high-stakes applications where compliance with domain knowledge is essential. A key bottleneck in this paradigm is the acquisition of symbolic constraints: encoding domain knowledge into logical formulas remains a manual and expert-intensive process. In this work, we investigate the extent to which auto-formalization via LLMs can systematically translate textual knowledge into symbolic knowledge that can be plugged into NeSy predictors. To this end, we introduce auto-nesy-bench, a new benchmark for evaluating constraint formalization and its impact on downstream accuracy of NeSy predictors. Through an extensive evaluation across several domains, we find that LLMs can formalize constraints to a meaningful extent, generating formulas that are often similar to those provided by human experts. Moreover, when the generated formulas are syntactically valid, they can lead to high-quality downstream predictions. The code and benchmark are available at https://unitn-sml.github.io/auto-nesy-bench/.
items.summary_zh: Auto-Formalizing Neuro-Symbolic Predictors 评估 LLM 将文本知识自动转成可插入神经符号预测器的逻辑约束，并观察约束形式化对下游预测的影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: auto-nesy-bench 同时检验公式形式化质量与下游效果，能区分“语法有效”与“真正改善预测”的差异，并提供代码和基准。
items.abstract_zh: 神经符号（Neuro-Symbolic，NeSy）预测器将先验知识纳入神经网络的预测过程，确保输出满足指定约束，因此特别适合必须遵守领域知识的高风险应用。这一范式的关键瓶颈是获取符号约束：将领域知识编码为逻辑公式仍是人工且高度依赖专家的过程。在本工作中，我们研究 LLM 自动形式化的程度，即系统地将文本知识转换为可以接入 NeSy 预测器的符号知识。为此，我们引入 auto-nesy-bench，一个评估约束形式化及其对 NeSy 预测器下游准确率影响的新基准。通过在多个领域开展广泛评估，我们发现 LLM 能在相当程度上形式化约束，生成的公式通常与人类专家提供的公式相似。此外，当生成的公式在语法上有效时，它们能够带来高质量的下游预测。代码和基准见 https://unitn-sml.github.io/auto-nesy-bench/。
items.author_line: Samuele Bortolotti, Weixin Chen, Han Zhao, Andrea Passerini, Stefano Teso, Antonio Vergari

items.title: ReSolve: Reusing Candidate Reasoning through Selective Generative Moderation
items.abstract_or_text: Sampling multiple solutions spends computation on intermediate deductions and unfinished arguments as well as final answers. We introduce ReSolve, a training-free inference procedure that reuses this candidate reasoning through selective generative moderation. An answer-distribution controller invokes a model to examine existing derivations when candidates disagree or lack a parseable answer, then incorporates the generated solution into a bounded loop. Under Hybrid scoring on 130 competition-mathematics problems evaluated with two independently sampled candidate pools, ReSolve obtains 100 and 99 correct answers, compared with 91 and 92 for voting over the same four candidates, with no correct-to-incorrect changes relative to that vote in either pool. Eight-sample self-consistency obtains 94 and 96 correct answers while consuming substantially more tokens; ReSolve uses 46.3% and 47.2% fewer tokens in the two evaluations. A controlled ablation removes visible derivations while retaining answer keys, vote counts, and the per-state output-cap rule, reducing accuracy from 100 to 93 correct despite increasing computation. Selective and always-on Uniform moderation both solve 97 problems, while selectivity reduces moderation tokens by approximately 54% and total pipeline tokens by 6.2%. These results support candidate reasoning as reusable inference computation. They do not establish an accuracy advantage over additional sampling or a distinct benefit from specialized route instructions.
items.summary_zh: ReSolve 在候选解不一致或答案不可解析时，对已有推导进行选择性生成式调解，并在有界循环中复用中间推理。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在两组独立候选池上，它用更少 token 达到高于四候选投票的正确数，并通过去除可见推导的消融检验中间推理确实发挥作用；摘要也明确了其结论边界。
items.abstract_zh: 多解采样会在中间推导、未完成论证和最终答案上都消耗计算。我们提出 ReSolve，一种无需训练的推理过程，通过选择性生成式调解来复用这些候选推理。当候选不一致或缺少可解析答案时，答案分布控制器会调用模型检查已有推导，然后将生成的解纳入有界循环。在两组独立采样候选池上，对 130 道竞赛数学题进行 Hybrid 评分时，ReSolve 分别得到 100 和 99 个正确答案；对相同的 4 个候选进行投票时则为 91 和 92 个，而且在任一候选池中，相对于该投票结果都没有出现从正确变为错误的情况。8 样本自洽得到 94 和 96 个正确答案，但消耗的 token 显著更多；ReSolve 在两次评测中分别少用 46.3% 和 47.2% 的 token。一项受控消融在保留答案键、投票数和每状态输出上限规则的同时去除可见推导，使准确率从 100 个正确答案降至 93 个，尽管计算量增加。选择性 Uniform 调解和始终启用的 Uniform 调解都解决了 97 道题，但选择性方案使调解 token 减少约 54%，使总流程 token 减少 6.2%。这些结果支持将候选推理作为可复用的推理计算，但并未证明其相对于额外采样具有准确率优势，也未证明专门的路由指令带来独立收益。
items.author_line: Bangji Yang, Jiajun Fan, Hongba Ma, Xi Zhu, Weizhi Zhang, Minghao Guo, Ye Li, Hamid Palangi, Jiaxuan You

items.title: Asynchronous LLM Post-Training: Group-Mass Capping and Convergence Analysis
items.abstract_or_text: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) improves the efficiency of large language model post-training but introduces stale rollouts generated by earlier policies. Theoretical understanding of how this staleness affects convergence and how to mitigate its impact remains limited. We derive a convergence bound for GRPO-style algorithms that explicitly characterizes the tradeoff between the gradient estimator's second moment and bias. For trajectory-level importance-weighted estimators, our analysis shows that once the second moment is uniformly controlled, delay enters the bound through the bias introduced by clipping or rescaling. Guided by this insight, we propose a novel group mass capping GRPO (GMC-GRPO) method, which minimizes a ratio-based bias bound within a class of weighted estimators sharing a common second-moment guarantee. We establish convergence guarantees for asynchronous GMC-GRPO and show that, compared with TIC-GRPO, it improves the threshold dependence of the fourth-order delay term from O(ε^{-4}) to O(ε^{-2}) as ε\to0, where 1+ε is the ratio threshold. Under local policy overlap, the delay-dependent term decreases as G^{-2/5} after tuning the step size, where G is the group size. For fixed behavior and current policies, the bias introduced by group rescaling also vanishes as G\to\infty, whereas the bias from trajectory-wise clipping can persist. Experiments across Qwen3 models and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate improved robustness to stale rollouts, with GMC-GRPO achieving the best performance among stable baselines under large rollout delays.
items.summary_zh: GMC-GRPO 从异步强化学习的梯度估计偏差与二阶矩权衡出发，给出收敛界并以组质量裁剪降低陈旧轨迹的影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 论文同时提供理论收敛分析、延迟项的阶数改进和 Qwen3 推理基准实验，适合检验数学推导是否对应实际训练稳定性。
items.abstract_zh: 异步强化学习（RL）提高大型语言模型后训练的效率，但会引入由较早策略生成的陈旧轨迹。关于这种陈旧性如何影响收敛以及如何减轻其影响，理论理解仍然有限。我们为 GRPO 风格算法推导了一个收敛界，明确刻画梯度估计器二阶矩与偏差之间的权衡。对于轨迹级重要性加权估计器，我们的分析表明，一旦二阶矩得到一致控制，延迟就会通过裁剪或重缩放引入的偏差进入界。受这一洞见启发，我们提出组质量裁剪 GRPO（group mass capping GRPO，GMC-GRPO）方法；在共享同一二阶矩保证的加权估计器类中，该方法最小化一个基于比率的偏差界。我们为异步 GMC-GRPO 建立收敛保证，并表明与 TIC-GRPO 相比，当 1+ε 为比率阈值且 ε→0 时，它将四阶延迟项对阈值的依赖从 O(ε^{-4}) 改进为 O(ε^{-2})。在局部策略重叠条件下，调节步长后，与延迟相关的项随组大小 G 按 G^{-2/5} 减小。对于固定的行为策略和当前策略，组重缩放引入的偏差也会在 G→∞ 时消失，而逐轨迹裁剪造成的偏差可能持续存在。在 Qwen3 模型和推理基准上的实验表明，GMC-GRPO 对陈旧轨迹更稳健；在较大 rollout 延迟下，它在稳定基线中取得最佳表现。
items.author_line: Qijia He, Ruinan Jin, Jun Luo, Shaofeng Zou, Yingbin Liang

items.title: Rethinking Probability-Based Reinforcement Learning From Posterior Concentration
items.abstract_or_text: Verifier-free reinforcement learning with probability-based rewards offers a promising way to train LLMs on general reasoning tasks where external verifiers are unavailable. Yet the reliability of these rewards, especially in long-horizon reasoning, remains underexplored. This work identifies a length-dependent failure mode of probability rewards, which we call the Posterior Concentration Phenomenon (PCP). We show that the probability of a reference answer conditioned on a reasoning trace often collapses to a low-variance interval as the trace becomes lengthy. This phenomenon results in nearly indistinguishable rewards, which, under GRPO-based settings, makes probability-based policy optimization unstable and inefficient. Motivated by this, we propose Reinforcement Learning with Concentration-aware Posterior Rewards (RLCPR), a verifier-free RL framework to explicitly account for PCP for better optimization stability and token efficiency. It has two components: uncertainty-aware data sampling, which reduces concentration-prone rollouts before generation, and concentration-aware regularization, which penalizes unnecessarily long traces when posterior rewards collapse. Extensive experiments show that, alongside higher token efficiency, RLCPR outperforms the state-of-the-art verifier-free RL baseline by up to 4.0% on six of seven benchmarks, including general-domain and mathematical reasoning challenges.
items.summary_zh: RLCPR 识别概率奖励在长推理轨迹上的后验集中现象，并用不确定性感知采样和长度正则化提升无验证器强化学习的稳定性与 token 效率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作先给出长度相关的奖励失效机制，再在 7 个基准上报告相对无验证器 RL 基线最多 4.0% 的提升，理论诊断与实验验证相互对应。
items.abstract_zh: 带概率奖励的无验证器强化学习为在缺少外部验证器的通用推理任务上训练 LLM 提供了有前景的方向。然而，这些奖励的可靠性，尤其是在长程推理中，仍缺乏充分研究。本工作识别出概率奖励的一种与长度相关的失效模式，并称之为后验集中现象（Posterior Concentration Phenomenon，PCP）。我们表明，给定一条推理轨迹时，参考答案的概率常常会随着轨迹变长而塌缩到一个低方差区间。该现象导致奖励几乎无法区分；在基于 GRPO 的设置下，它使基于概率的策略优化变得不稳定且低效。针对这一点，我们提出带集中感知后验奖励的强化学习（Reinforcement Learning with Concentration-aware Posterior Rewards，RLCPR），这是一个无验证器强化学习框架，明确考虑 PCP，以提高优化稳定性和 token 效率。它包含两个部分：不确定性感知的数据采样，在生成前减少容易发生集中的轨迹；以及集中感知正则化，在后验奖励塌缩时惩罚不必要的长轨迹。大量实验表明，RLCPR 在提高 token 效率的同时，在 7 个基准中的 6 个上超过最先进的无验证器 RL 基线，最高提升 4.0%，这些基准包括通用领域和数学推理挑战。
items.author_line: Shiu-Hong Kao, Yubo Zhao, Zhenyu Tian, Pengzhan Sun, Yicong Li, Angela Yao

items.title: When Does a Second Model Help? Cross-Model Review in LLM Verification
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models now generate code, documentation, and analyses, and are increasingly used to review such output. We ask when a second review by a different model helps. Building on the author's earlier preprints, which varied context, repetition, and role structure within one model, we test model independence in a controlled experiment: 30 artifacts with 150 planted errors, 10 review conditions, and 900 review sessions with three reviewer models from two developers. In this experiment, (1) a top-tier cross-model reviewer is not significantly different in F1 from same-model review in a fresh session (CCR), which does not establish equivalence; (2) the two find partly different errors (Jaccard 41.2%); and (3) at two review calls, one CCR plus one cross-model review matches more planted errors than two CCR reviews (56.7% vs. 42.7%; Holm-adjusted p=.006), but not significantly more than two reviews by the top-tier cross-model reviewer, so model difference and reviewer capability are not separated. A lightweight cross-model reviewer scores no higher than same-model review. Withholding requirements from the reviewer raises F1 for the two lower tiers but not the top tier, in untested point estimates whose pattern depends on how failed sessions are scored. Before analysis we audited all session records, excluding one baseline run of uncertain provenance and 14 failed calls; results with all sessions are also reported. A partial check on public detector outputs from another benchmark neither replicates nor contradicts the main comparison. Records, artifacts, and scripts are available from the author on request.
items.summary_zh: 该受控实验研究不同模型的第二次审阅何时有帮助，比较同模型复审与跨模型复审在植入错误检测上的互补性，并报告统计显著性与分析排除项。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 30 个工件、150 个植入错误和 900 次审阅构成清晰任务；结果同时报告显著提升、未建立等价、模型能力混淆和数据审计限制，结论较为克制。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型如今可以生成代码、文档和分析，也越来越多地被用于审阅这些输出。我们研究由不同模型进行第二次审阅何时有帮助。在作者先前预印本研究单模型内上下文、重复和角色结构的基础上，我们在受控实验中检验模型独立性：使用 30 个工件、150 个植入错误、10 种审阅条件，以及来自两家开发者的 3 个审阅模型，共进行 900 次审阅。在该实验中：（1）顶级跨模型审阅者与新会话中的同模型审阅在 F1 上没有显著差异（CCR），但这并未建立等价性；（2）两者发现的错误部分不同（Jaccard 41.2%）；（3）在两次审阅调用下，一次 CCR 加一次跨模型审阅比两次 CCR 审阅发现了更多植入错误（56.7% 对 42.7%；Holm 校正后的 p=.006），但并不显著多于由顶级跨模型审阅者进行的两次审阅，因此模型差异和审阅者能力尚未分离。轻量级跨模型审阅者的得分不高于同模型审阅。向审阅者隐去要求后，两个较低层级的审阅者 F1 反而升高，而顶级审阅者没有升高；这些尚未检验的点估计，其模式取决于如何对失败会话计分。分析前，我们审计了所有会话记录，排除了一个来源不确定的基线运行和 14 次失败调用；同时也报告了包含全部会话的结果。对另一基准的公开检测器输出进行的部分检查既未复现也未否定主要比较。记录、工件和脚本可向作者索取。
items.author_line: Tae-Eun Song

items.title: Agents Are Systems, Not Models: Rethinking Agentic Evaluation
items.abstract_or_text: Agent evaluations increasingly go beyond a single success rate, reporting metrics such as cost, consistency, and robustness. Yet they typically treat the agent itself as fixed. In practice, an agent is a configurable system: users decide what to tell it, how long to let it run, and which model to use, and each of these choices can change how well and how consistently it performs. We study these choices on a new benchmark of four scientific tasks, where a coding agent must find and correctly operate a published specialist model. We investigate five parts of the agent's configuration: task information, reasoning, self-verification, time budget, and backbone model. We find substantial run-to-run variability, with approximately 54% of the outcome variance coming from repeating the same configuration rather than changing it. Across configurations, the information provided to the agent has the largest effect, exceeding both time budget and model size, while also reducing cost and improving calibration. Configuration choices also interact: additional time helps only when the agent has sufficient information or a capable enough model to use it. Finally, a trajectory-based taxonomy of agent behavior reveals that prompting an agent to verify its answer has little effect on its verification behavior, whereas providing a dedicated verification tool changes that behavior substantially. These results suggest that agents should be evaluated as configurable systems themselves, and that some desired behaviors are more effectively implemented in the system than requested through prompting. We release the benchmark and more than 18,000 agent trajectories.
items.summary_zh: 该研究把代理视为可配置系统，系统考察任务信息、推理、自验证、时间预算和骨干模型对科学任务代理表现的影响，并分析重复运行方差。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 四项科学任务、超过 18,000 条轨迹和可复现配置对照显示，信息配置与专用验证工具可能比单纯增加时间或模型规模更关键。
items.abstract_zh: 代理评测日益超越单一成功率，开始报告成本、一致性和稳健性等指标。然而，它们通常将代理本身视为固定的。实际上，代理是一个可配置系统：用户决定告诉它什么、允许它运行多久以及使用哪个模型，而这些选择都可能改变其表现和一致性。我们在一个包含四项科学任务的新基准上研究这些选择；在这些任务中，编程代理必须找到并正确操作一个已发表的专业模型。我们考察代理配置的五个部分：任务信息、推理、自验证、时间预算和骨干模型。我们发现运行之间存在显著变异：约 54% 的结果方差来自重复相同配置，而不是改变配置。在不同配置之间，提供给代理的信息影响最大，超过时间预算和模型规模；同时它还能降低成本并改善校准。配置选择还会交互作用：只有当代理获得足够信息或拥有足够强的模型来利用这些信息时，额外时间才有帮助。最后，基于轨迹的代理行为分类显示，提示代理验证答案对其验证行为影响很小，而提供专用验证工具会显著改变这种行为。这些结果表明，应将代理自身作为可配置系统来评测；某些期望行为通过系统实现比通过提示要求更有效。我们公开了该基准和超过 18,000 条代理轨迹。
items.author_line: Luis Wiedmann, Leander Girrbach, Cordelia Schmid, Zeynep Akata

items.title: Dependency-Aware Reward Shaping for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.abstract_or_text: When training large language models with reinforcement learning, terminal rewards provide little guidance about which steps matter. Common methods for assigning step credit overlook that work built on uncorrected mistakes is wasted while independent work remains valid. With only a final success/failure reward, every step in a failed episode has zero total future reward, even when it made progress. We propose Dependency-Aware Reward Shaping (DARS), which represents task progress as predicates linked by prerequisite relations and assigns step-level credit over the dependency graph. An annotator marks which predicates each step verifies, invalidates, or repairs. Verified predicates are discounted according to graph distance from the nearest broken prerequisite, while independent predicates are unaffected. Repairs update these weights based on any errors that remain; invalidated predicates need re-verification to regain credit. A fixed potential converts these annotations into signed per-step rewards. A common reward and annotation interface allows DARS to integrate with a range of reasoning and agentic training methods, such as GiGPO and ARPO/AEPO, without changing their rollout strategies or optimizers. Across five task families and models from 1.5B to 8B, DARS improves success by up to 10 points over GiGPO trained with the same budget and harness (ALFWorld), raises the WebShop task score and Search-R1 QA accuracy, complements AEPO's entropy-based training on AIME24/25 with a Python interpreter, and exceeds OmniOPD in controlled tool-free reasoning comparisons at 1.7B and 4B. Ablations show that step-level credit, dependency attenuation, and graph topology each contribute. On ALFWorld, a distilled 8B annotator matches the API annotator, enabling DARS to run efficiently without a frontier judge. Code is available at https://github.com/JianhuiWei7/DARS.
items.summary_zh: DARS 用带前置依赖的谓词图分配步骤级信用：错误依赖链上的工作被衰减，独立谓词不受影响，并通过固定势函数转成有符号奖励。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 5 类任务、1.5B–8B 模型和 AIME24/25 等推理设置上，消融拆分了步骤信用、依赖衰减与图拓扑的贡献，验证器和代码也公开。
items.abstract_zh: 使用强化学习训练大型语言模型时，终止奖励很少能指导哪些步骤真正重要。常见的步骤信用分配方法忽略了这样一个事实：建立在未纠正错误之上的工作是无效的，而独立工作仍然有效。在只有最终成功/失败奖励时，即使失败回合中的某一步取得了进展，该回合的每一步未来总奖励仍为零。我们提出依赖感知奖励塑形（Dependency-Aware Reward Shaping，DARS），用由前置关系连接的谓词表示任务进度，并在依赖图上分配步骤级信用。标注者标记每一步验证、使其失效或修复了哪些谓词。已验证谓词的信用按照其到最近损坏前置项的图距离进行折扣，而独立谓词不受影响。修复操作会根据剩余错误更新这些权重；失效谓词必须重新验证才能恢复信用。一个固定势函数将这些标注转换为带符号的逐步奖励。统一的奖励和标注接口使 DARS 能与多种推理和代理训练方法（如 GiGPO 和 ARPO/AEPO）集成，而无需改变其 rollout 策略或优化器。在 5 类任务和 1.5B 至 8B 模型上，DARS 在 ALFWorld 上以相同预算和工具链训练时，相比 GiGPO 将成功率最多提高 10 个百分点；它提高了 WebShop 任务分数和 Search-R1 问答准确率，在带 Python 解释器的 AIME24/25 上补充 AEPO 的基于熵训练，并在受控的无工具推理比较中以 1.7B 和 4B 模型超过 OmniOPD。消融实验表明，步骤级信用、依赖衰减和图拓扑都各自有贡献。在 ALFWorld 上，蒸馏的 8B 标注器达到与 API 标注器相当的表现，使 DARS 无需前沿评判器即可高效运行。代码见 https://github.com/JianhuiWei7/DARS。
items.author_line: Ziyi Chen, Yan Zhang, Jianhui Wei, Daoan Zhang, Zuozhu Liu

items.title: Selection-Based Structured Reasoning: Toward Efficient Multimodal Search Agents
items.abstract_or_text: Multimodal agents commonly generate free-form reasoning before each action. For small models, limited model capacity can result in lengthy reasoning that provides little useful guidance for action generation while incurring substantial inference cost. To address this challenge, we introduce Selection-based Structured Reasoning (SSR), a framework that reformulates reasoning as selection instead of open-ended generation. SSR represents recurring high-level reasoning as pre-specified, reusable natural-language candidates. At each turn, the model selects from these reasoning candidates based on their likelihoods given the current context, without requiring an auxiliary task head. Using pre-specified reasoning traces enables parallel scoring, where teacher-forced prefilling computes token likelihoods concurrently within and across candidates using a shared context KV cache. We evaluate SSR on seven multimodal search benchmarks using 2B and 4B models. Across multiple reinforcement learning objectives and supervised fine-tuning, SSR delivers significant efficiency gains without sacrificing task performance. SSR achieves an average success rate competitive with leading search agents of the same scale, while reducing per-turn reasoning latency by over 90% and total per-question model inference latency by 28-54%. Project page: https://zfy0314.github.io/ssr-webpage/.
items.summary_zh: SSR 把多模态代理的开放式推理改写为从预设候选推理轨迹中选择，并利用共享上下文 KV cache 并行计算候选似然。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 7 个多模态搜索基准和 2B/4B 模型上，它报告了保持任务性能同时超过 90% 的每轮推理延迟下降，任务与效率指标都可直接核验。
items.abstract_zh: 多模态代理通常在每次行动前生成自由形式的推理。对于小模型而言，有限的模型能力可能导致生成冗长推理，而这些推理对行动生成帮助很小，却带来很高的推理成本。为解决这一问题，我们提出基于选择的结构化推理（Selection-based Structured Reasoning，SSR）框架，将推理从开放式生成重新表述为选择。SSR 将反复出现的高层推理表示为预先指定、可复用的自然语言候选。在每一轮中，模型根据当前上下文的条件似然从这些推理候选中选择，而不需要额外的任务头。使用预先指定的推理轨迹可以进行并行评分：教师强制预填充在共享上下文 KV cache 下，同时计算候选内部及候选之间的 token 似然。我们在 7 个多模态搜索基准上使用 2B 和 4B 模型评估 SSR。在多种强化学习目标和监督微调设置下，SSR 在不牺牲任务性能的情况下带来显著效率提升。SSR 的平均成功率与同规模领先搜索代理相当，同时将每轮推理延迟降低 90% 以上，将每题模型总推理延迟降低 28%–54%。项目主页：https://zfy0314.github.io/ssr-webpage/。

items.title: Screw Attention: Rigid-Body Algebra Inside a Transformer
items.abstract_or_text: Learned manipulation policies rediscover from data the spatial relations that rigid-body mechanics supplies in closed form. This costs data, and it leaves the policies fragile to geometric changes in the scene. We present Screw Attention, a transformer layer in which the relation between two bodies is a spatial transform rather than a graph edge. Every token is a body with a pose. Each pair of tokens carries the relative pose and, for robot joints, the joint screw. Messages are transported along this relation into the receiver's frame, while the attention scores see only frame-invariant quantities. By construction, the messages are equivariant to an independent change of frame at every token, and a single layer can express the velocity recursion of rigid-body mechanics. On simulated manipulation tasks, Screw Attention matches or outperforms controls of the same size, including graph, transformer and flat networks on LIBERO-Spatial. With 16,162 parameters it reaches 97.3% on LIBERO-Spatial from object poses (without images or language), above a flat network with 27x more parameters. Under a change of per-link frame convention its success is unchanged, while every other learned network falls below 3%. Placed on an analytic controller as a gated residual, it raises insertion success by 17.3 points. It is unaffected by pose noise up to 10,mm and by joint offsets within the factory calibration of a Franka arm. These results suggest a criterion: geometry is decisive when the task requires relations between frames that no other part of the system supplies. Code and trained policies will be released.
items.summary_zh: Screw Attention 将刚体空间变换和关节螺旋代数直接嵌入 Transformer，使消息在接收者坐标系中传递、注意力只使用坐标系不变量，并测试其等变性与操控性能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 论文给出明确的坐标系变换、参数量、LIBERO-Spatial 成功率、噪声鲁棒性和解析控制器增益，可检验“结构化几何归纳偏置”是否带来真实收益。
items.abstract_zh: 学习到的操控策略会从数据中重新发现刚体力学以闭式形式提供的空间关系。这会增加数据需求，也使策略对场景中的几何变化更加脆弱。我们提出 Screw Attention，一种 Transformer 层，其中两个物体之间的关系不是图边，而是空间变换。每个 token 都是一个带位姿的物体。每一对 token 携带相对位姿；对于机器人关节，还携带关节螺旋。消息沿该关系传送到接收者坐标系中，而注意力分数只查看与坐标系无关的量。按构造，对每个 token 独立改变坐标系时，消息保持等变；单层即可表达刚体力学中的速度递推。在模拟操控任务上，Screw Attention 在 LIBERO-Spatial 上达到或超过同规模的图网络、Transformer 和扁平网络等对照模型。仅使用物体位姿（不使用图像或语言）时，它以 16,162 个参数达到 97.3% 的 LIBERO-Spatial 成功率，高于参数量多 27 倍的扁平网络。在改变每个连杆的坐标系约定时，它的成功率保持不变，而其他每个学习型网络都降至 3% 以下。将其作为门控残差置于解析控制器上时，插入成功率提高 17.3 个百分点。对于最高 10 mm 的位姿噪声以及 Franka 机械臂出厂校准范围内的关节偏移，它都不受影响。这些结果提出了一个判据：当任务需要不同坐标系之间的关系、而系统其他部分无法提供这种关系时，几何结构至关重要。代码和训练好的策略将发布。
